data.name: Witchland: Trinity Blight
data.detailed_description:
🜂 Witchland: Trinity Blight

A dark tactical roguelite with lethal hex-grid combat, dual combat styles for every hero, and a token-based progression system where each choice reshapes your build.

Survive 28 days as the world slips deeper into decay.

🌑 Choose Your Starting Pair. Shape Your Fate.

Each run begins with one of three starting duos — Inquisition, Frontier, or Tribal.
Your opening pair defines your early abilities, combat tempo, and difficulty curve.

As the journey unfolds, you may recruit up to two additional heroes, forming a four-person squad.

The full game features six unique heroes, each with a distinct role, tone, and two Combat Styles that fundamentally change how they fight.

⚔️ Dual Combat Styles for Every Hero

Witchland’s combat revolves around short, lethal exchanges on a hex battlefield.

Each hero can switch between two contrasting styles, such as:

  • precise ranged shots vs. close-range assassinations

  • heavy hammer strikes vs. protective rituals

  • disciplined human form vs. unleashed feral form

Switching styles alters your action economy, threat profile, and the tactical rhythm of your team.

🜄 Token System — Build Through Decisions, Not Stats

After each victory, you select one token that permanently evolves a hero.

All progression is expressed through tokens, divided into four functional types:

  • Ability Tokens — unlock entirely new active abilities

  • Modifier Tokens — transform existing abilities with new mechanics

  • Positioning Tokens — reward adjacency and spatial play

  • Utility Tokens — provide situational advantages and momentum

Tokens introduce small rules with major tactical impact: execution triggers, reaction attacks, altered ability patterns, and powerful positional synergies.

Your strength grows through choices — not inflated numbers.

🜇 A World That Weakens Every Dawn

Witchland is a forgotten frontier of abandoned villages, ruined camps, and mist-drowned roads where human life has already vanished.

The Trinity Blight spreads across the land — three interwoven forces of decay that rule their dying domains.
Their influence grows each sunrise, and all must fall before the 28th day, or the land is lost forever.

Travel across a procedurally generated map of battlefields, relic arenas, and fragile moments of rest, knowing you’ll never see everything in a single run.

🜉 Key Features

  • Hex-grid tactical combat focused on lethal precision

  • Dual Combat Styles that redefine each hero’s battlefield role

  • Token-based progression built on abilities, modifiers, and positioning

  • Six unique heroes from three thematic factions

  • Recruit up to two additional heroes (party size up to four)

  • 28-day roguelite campaign with rising decay and pressure

  • Procedurally generated routes ensuring high replayability

  • Dark gothic atmosphere of fog, rot, and fading civilization

🜏 Witchland: Trinity Blight is a story of survival, resolve, and the cost of every passing day.

data.short_description: Lead bound warriors in brutal turn-based tactical combat across a cursed land once ruled by witches. Plan your positioning carefully, adapt your abilities, and survive deadly encounters in every battle.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X (DirectX 11 compatible)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580 (DirectX 11/12 compatible)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes:
Witchland: Trinity Blight contains dark fantasy themes and stylized combat violence involving cursed creatures and hostile enemies.

The game includes depictions of injury, death, and decay presented in a non-graphic, fictional manner, as well as a dark and oppressive atmosphere.

The game does not contain sexual content, sexual violence, nudity, or erotic material, and does not depict drug use, self-harm, or substance abuse.
